segments.name: Mortgage Insurance
segments.description: Provides private mortgage insurance and reinsurance under GSE credit risk transfer programs.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single reportable segment, which is defined as Mortgage Insurance. This segment generates revenue through mortgage insurance and reinsurance provided under the GSEs credit risk transfer programs.

revenueModel.text: Lenders pay premiums for mortgage insurance coverage on low down payment residential loans, reducing losses from homeowner defaults.
revenueModel.evidence: PMI covers losses from homeowner defaults on residential mortgage loans, reducing, and in some instances eliminating, the loss to the insured institution.
